{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=4|time=4 hours|difficulty=3}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Holiday Recipes|Holiday Recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]] 

==Ingredients==

* 5 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]], at room temperature
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[cookbook:Cream of Tartar|cream of tartar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] plus 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]], divided
* ⅛ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]] fresh [[Cookbook:Raspberry|raspberries]]
* 1 tablespoon toasted hazelnut oil
* 1⅓ cups [[Cookbook:Creme Anglaise|hazelnut creme anglaise]], chilled

==Procedure==

# Heat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|200°F (90ºC)]].
# In the bowl of a standing [[Cookbook:Mixer|mixer]] or with a hand-held mixer, [[Cookbook:Whipping|whip]] egg whites and cream of tartar on high speed until soft peaks form, about 1 minute.
# Reduce mixer speed to low and add 1 cup sugar in a steady stream; continue whipping until stiff and glossy, about 4 minutes.
# Whip in cinnamon.
# Fill a [[Cookbook:Pastry Bag|pastry bag]] fitted with a medium star tip with the meringue.
# Onto a [[Cookbook:Silpat|Silpat]] or oiled piece of [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]], pipe the mixture into rounds, starting in the center and moving outward in a spiral to form a 3-inch disk.
# Bake for 2 hours, until crisp but not browned.
# Cool on the Silpat or parchment, then carefully remove the meringues.
# Set aside, uncovered, on a wire rack in a cool, dry place.
# Increase oven temperature to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]].
# [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] raspberries with remaining 1 tablespoon sugar and hazelnut oil.
# Mound the berries on a baking sheet lined with Silpat or parchment paper and roast them for about 5 minutes, until glistening and very fragrant, but not mushy.
# Remove from the oven.
# Pour ⅓ cup of chilled hazelnut creme anglaise into the middle of a soup plate.
# Place a cooled meringue in the center, then spoon ¼ of the roasted raspberries on top of each meringue.
# Serve immediately.
